description: This file is a Perl script that functions as a utility for flashing firmware onto Linksys ADSL2MUE devices. It includes network communication, device discovery, FTP interactions, and data transfer for firmware updates.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with the ADSL device, including user authentication, environment variable retrieval, reboot command, and specialized FTP commands.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Send the USER command to authenticate.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieve environment variable value through FTP command.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variable.
